$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. ForkLineage realizes LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.9's ForkLineage concept, detailed normatively in LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md (FB-RAT-LIN-001..007; LIN-007 DEFERRED). Field-list expansion beyond the task brief's literal enumeration (forkId, parentReleaseRef, forkReason, authorshipContributions, licenseRef, attributionRequired, upstreamRelationship, lastComparedAgainstUpstream) is grounded directly in that document's §2 'Objects' list and §3/§5/§9/§11 normative text, not invented: `initiatingActor`+`createdAtUtc` (§3, required fork-creation fields), `lineageEvents` (§2's append-only lineage-event vocabulary — FORK_CREATED..LOCAL_FORK_DELETED, seven values, verbatim), `appliedUpstreamOperations` (§2's 'Applied upstream change set', §7/§10), `licenseCompatibilityFinding` (§5's publish-time LOOP-LINEAGE-002 gate), `publication` (§11's derivative-publication declarations), and `authorityDiffSinceFork` (this same work package's standalone authority-diff.schema.json, consumed here per that document's own header note). `lastComparedAgainstUpstream` is a pointer to a loop-semantic-diff.schema.json document (written by the sibling definition-authoring group, cross-referenced by ID here, never embedded) — per the task brief, 'this is exactly where FB-RAT-LIN-004's per-category diff and FB-RAT-LIN-005's independent authority diff get consumed,' so this document does not re-derive the nine-category report or the four-condition blocking-review group; `authorityDiffSinceFork` below is a DIFFERENT, narrower field — the capability-only comparison between this fork's CURRENT authority requests and its PARENT's requests AT FORK TIME (§3), independent of any later upstream-comparison session §10 walks through.
title: ForkLineage
description: A provenance record connecting a derivative draft or release to its parent release(s), applied upstream changes, authorship, attribution, and license (LOOP_FORK_LINEAGE_CONTRACT.md, FB-RAT-LIN-001..006). Created at fork time (§3) and updated in place as lineage events accumulate (§2, §12 'lineage events are append-only') — this schema does not itself enforce append-only growth of `lineageEvents`/`appliedUpstreamOperations` across successive versions of the same document (a store-level obligation over time, not a single-instance structural property, matching this corpus's established pattern for the same class of gap — see loop-installation.schema.json's identical immutability-invariant caveat).

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this record's shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

forkId.description: The fork draft's own draftId (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §14 'draftId identifies mutable authoring state and is never reused after deletion'), minted at fork time (§2 'Fork draft identity', §3).

parentReleaseRef.description: §3's Parent reference — the immutable {loopId, semanticVersion, packageDigest} tuple this fork was created from (§2: 'every lineage object below names a parent by this tuple, never by a mutable pointer such as a listing URL'). `packageDigest` here matches this work package's task-brief field name; the underlying value is exactly LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md's packageContentDigest (naming-drift note per loop-release.schema.json's own precedent, not a semantic conflict).

initiatingActor.description: §3: 'the initiating actor,' using §2's actor-class vocabulary (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §15, reused not reinvented per §3's own cross-reference).

authorshipContributions.description: §2's Contribution/author record, one per contributing author — required non-empty: a fork with zero recorded authorship is exactly LOOP-LINEAGE-001's 'missing parent attribution' condition (loop-validation-rules.v1.json).

licenseRef.description: §2's License and attribution record, §5's carry-through obligation.

attributionRequired.description: Whether the parent's license/terms require attribution to be preserved and displayed (§5). This is a declared FACT about the parent's terms, not itself the enforcement — §5's preservation obligations apply regardless of this flag's value; the flag exists so a consuming UI knows whether to surface attribution prominently.

upstreamRelationship.description: NONE: fork has diverged and tracks no ongoing upstream relationship. TRACKING: fork's lineage still references its parent family for future upstream-comparison sessions (§6, §10). REBASED: fork owner performed a manual rebase (§6's fifth choice) — outside §10's automated machine. Null before any upstream-relationship posture has been established.

lastComparedAgainstUpstream.description: Pointer to the most recent loop-semantic-diff.schema.json document produced by §10's COMPARING -> DIFF_READY transition (sourceKind=LINEAGE_COMPARISON) — carries BOTH the nine-category §8 report and the §9 blocking-review-group in one referenced object, per this document's header note. Null before any comparison has run.

authorityDiffSinceFork.description: The narrower, standalone authority-diff.schema.json shape (this work package's cross-domain reusable object) — a capability-only comparison between this fork's CURRENT authority requests and its parent's requests AT FORK TIME, independent of any later upstream-comparison session. Distinct from `lastComparedAgainstUpstream`'s fuller diff. Null when no such comparison has been computed.

appliedUpstreamOperations.description: §2's Applied upstream change set — §7/§10: 'each accepted upstream operation MUST be applied to a new local revision individually, never batched.' Append-only in practice (§12); this schema does not itself enforce monotonic growth (see this document's top-level description).

lineageEvents.description: §2's append-only lineage-event record — at minimum FORK_CREATED, UPSTREAM_COMPARED, UPSTREAM_OPERATION_APPLIED, FORK_REVISION_CREATED_FROM_UPSTREAM, SUBLOOP_EXTRACTED, DERIVATIVE_PUBLISHED, LOCAL_FORK_DELETED (verbatim, §2). This is the enforcement surface LOOP-LINEAGE-001 (loop-validation-rules.v1.json) checks against.

licenseCompatibilityFinding.description: §5: 'A derivative's declared license MUST be checked for compatibility with its parent's license before the derivative may publish... blocked from publication' if INCOMPATIBLE (LOOP-LINEAGE-002, loop-validation-rules.v1.json). Null before this fork has ever been evaluated for publication. See this schema's allOf: `publication` MUST NOT be present unless this is exactly COMPATIBLE.

publication.description: §11: FB-RAT-LIN-006's declared-derivative fields, populated only once this fork has actually been published. Null for an unpublished (or not-yet-evaluated-for-publication) fork.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: §5/LOOP-LINEAGE-002: a fork whose license is not COMPATIBLE with its parent MUST be blocked from publication — a non-null `publication` therefore requires licenseCompatibilityFinding=COMPATIBLE. This schema cannot verify the CONVERSE (that publication.publishedLoopId actually differs from parentReleaseRef.loopId unless ownership was transferred, §11) — cross-field string-inequality is not expressible generically in JSON Schema without knowing the compared value ahead of time; documented here as an acknowledged gap, matching this corpus's established pattern (see loop-draft.schema.json's own acknowledged VALID-with-ERROR-findings gap) rather than left unstated.

LicenseRef.description: At least one of the three MUST be a non-blank string — feeds LOOP-LINEAGE-* checks. Same shape as LoopDefinitionContracts.kt's LicenseRef, duplicated locally.

AuthorityDiff.description: Duplicated locally from authority-diff.schema.json, per this corpus's standalone-schema convention — same shape, same structural requiresFreshApproval enforcement.

opId.description: The loop-semantic-diff.schema.json SemanticOperation.opId that was accepted and applied (§7, §10).

publishedLoopId.description: §11: 'A published derivative MUST receive a new, stable loop family ID, distinct from its parent's, unless ownership of the parent family is formally transferred.'

listingRef.description: Pointer to the loop-listing.schema.json record, once published.

ownershipTransferred.description: §3, §11: true only when the parent publisher's policy explicitly transferred ownership of the parent family to this fork's publisher — the sole condition under which `publishedLoopId` MAY equal the parent's loopId.
